summary: The Codex calm-flow reset made runtime behavior and parity claims honest, but several command contracts still bridge through legacy Claude markdown bodies, so full command-surface independence is not yet mechanical.
evidence: This batch delivered a real Codex control plane, regenerated adapter projections, and corrected docs/roadmap wording to stop overstating parity. However the canonical command contracts still include remaining legacy bridges such as commands/session-closeout/command.yaml -> .claude/commands/session-closeout.md. As long as those bridges remain, parity depends on claim discipline and mirror hygiene rather than on full neutral-body independence.
recommended_action: Open a governed migration track for legacy bridge retirement, scoped per command. Prioritize start, next, and session-closeout first, then auto/deliver/deliver-full. Require each slice to land canonical body migration, projection regeneration, and cross-platform behavior tests together before parity claims are advanced.
